output.content: I was checking the deployment logs for the last three model releases. Each time the main build finished, the shadow deployment stayed idle. No job started automatically. I had to open the console, find the shadow environment, and manually run the deploy script for each release. The gap between the main build finishing and the shadow deployment starting was between forty and ninety minutes, depending on when I noticed it. There is no webhook or scheduled trigger linking the two. The shadow environment only updates when I remember to push the code over myself.
